sources.title: RFC 8762: Simple Two-Way Active Measurement Protocol
sources.titleEn: RFC 8762: Simple Two-Way Active Measurement Protocol
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: IP Capacity：觀測速率、容量與負載邊界
related.titleEn: IP capacity: observed rate, capacity and load boundaries
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受5% deadline miss與2%最終未觀察，不能混成同一服務品質指標。 交接時須能核對：交付 stamp-sequences.csv、重排序時間圖與去重測試。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Accept5% deadline misses and2% final unobserved replies as distinct service metrics. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver stamp-sequences.csv, reordered timelines and deduplication tests.
related.difference: 以開始／結束時間及IP byte計數建立觀測表，另列未計入的鏈路封裝。
related.differenceEn: Record interval endpoints and IP-byte counters and separately list excluded link framing.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
STAMP量測需以session及序號關聯；重排和重複回覆不能直接當丟失或額外成功。
教學基準：(100-95)/100*100 = 5 %；對照：(100-98)/100*100 = 2 %。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

IP容量量測需明確封包層級、時間窗及方法；一段成功傳輸速率不是路徑容量的無條件證明。
教學基準：12000000*8/0.8/1000000 = 120 Mb/s observed；對照：12000000*8/1.2/1000000 = 80 Mb/s observed。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
STAMP measurements join by session and sequence; reordered or duplicate replies are not automatically losses or extra successes.
Teaching baseline: (100-95)/100*100 = 5 %; comparison: (100-98)/100*100 = 2 %. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

IP-capacity measurement requires explicit packet layer, time window and method; one successful transfer rate does not unconditionally prove path capacity.
Teaching baseline: 12000000*8/0.8/1000000 = 120 Mb/s observed; comparison: 12000000*8/1.2/1000000 = 80 Mb/s observed. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: OFDM 循環字首：延遲擴散與有效時間
related.titleEn: OFDM cyclic prefix: delay spread and useful time
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受5% deadline miss與2%最終未觀察，不能混成同一服務品質指標。 交接時須能核對：交付 stamp-sequences.csv、重排序時間圖與去重測試。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Accept5% deadline misses and2% final unobserved replies as distinct service metrics. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver stamp-sequences.csv, reordered timelines and deduplication tests.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋80 %與88.8888888889 %，建立ofdm_timeline.csv、通道抽頭、CP邊界圖，並完成以下驗收：第二組時間效率較高但不滿足延遲界限；選16 microsecond後仍保留定時誤差餘裕檢查。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 80 % and 88.8888888889 %; create ofdm_timeline.csv, channel taps and CP-boundary plot; apply this acceptance decision: The second case has better time efficiency but violates the delay bound; select16 microseconds and separately reserve timing margin.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
STAMP量測需以session及序號關聯；重排和重複回覆不能直接當丟失或額外成功。
教學基準：(100-95)/100*100 = 5 %；對照：(100-98)/100*100 = 2 %。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

從原理 理想CP-OFDM有效時間比例Tu/(Tu+Tcp)；CP必須覆蓋通道記憶與定時誤差，不能單為效率無限縮短。 展開基準式 64/(64+16)*100；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：逐符元畫64+16與64+8的時間軸；比較10 microsecond通道尾巴是否越過CP。 將兩條推導一起存入 ofdm_timeline.csv、通道抽頭、CP邊界圖。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
STAMP measurements join by session and sequence; reordered or duplicate replies are not automatically losses or extra successes.
Teaching baseline: (100-95)/100*100 = 5 %; comparison: (100-98)/100*100 = 2 %. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

Starting from Ideal CP-OFDM useful-time fraction is Tu/(Tu+Tcp); CP must cover channel memory and timing error rather than simply being minimized., expand baseline expression 64/(64+16)*100; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Draw64+16 and64+8 symbol timelines and test whether the10 microsecond channel tail exceeds the CP. Save both derivations with ofdm_timeline.csv, channel taps and CP-boundary plot.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
